title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population under social influence, policy mandates, enforcement, messaging, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: People observe and communicate with social neighbors; adoption propensity changes with the fraction of peers wearing masks and received messages.

interactions.name: policy_compliance
interactions.description: PolicyAuthority issues mandates; individuals adjust mask decisions based on mandate status, enforcement probability, and fines.

interactions.name: location_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask requirements at entry or within premises, influencing immediate wearing behavior and potential penalties.

interactions.name: retail_supply
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from retailers subject to price, inventory, and purchase limits; supply constraints affect adoption.

interactions.name: media_influence
interactions.description: Media channels broadcast messaging that shifts risk perception and perceived norms, impacting adoption.

interactions.name: observational_norms_in_location
interactions.description: Individuals update their wearing decision within a location based on visible local compliance (normative pressure).

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption rate first reaches or exceeds 50%.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate over the simulation period.

metrics.name: steady_state_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Mean adoption rate over the final evaluation window (e.g., last 20% of time steps).

metrics.name: mandate_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rate attributable to mandate (with vs. without policy), holding other factors constant.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity of adoption across demographic groups (e.g., Gini or coefficient of variation).

metrics.name: noncompliance_under_mandate
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals not wearing masks when mandates are active.
